request.questionText: A boxplot of commute times has a median near 24 minutes, Q1 near 18 minutes, Q3 near 36 minutes, and a long upper whisker ending near 70 minutes. Which summary is best supported by the graph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The distribution is roughly symmetric with no long tail.

choices.label: B
choices.text: About half of commute times fall between 18 and 36 minutes, and the distribution is right-skewed.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Most commute times are less than 18 minutes.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The mean commute time must be exactly 24 minutes.
